company: Together AI was founded in 2022 by Vipul Ved Prakash, Stanford professor Percy Liang and Ce Zhang. It offers a cloud platform optimized for open-source AI models, letting companies run, fine-tune and train models without building their own GPU clusters.

In July 2026 Together AI raised an $800 million Series C led by Aramco Ventures, with Vista, General Catalyst and Nvidia participating, at an $8.3 billion valuation, up from $3.3 billion in its February 2025 Series B. It reported more than $1.15 billion in annual bookings.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Together AI is a leading bet on open-source AI models, and a read-through for whether specialist AI clouds can compete with hyperscalers and CoreWeave.

takeaways: The valuation grew about 2.5 times in 17 months.
Its growth depends on companies choosing open-source models.
Bookings are large, but GPU costs are heavy.
Hyperscalers and other neoclouds compete directly.
